thread:
elaine: Quick PSA 1: the big black canister of 'house blend' beans has gone missing from the counter. anyone know where it went? barista-bot showed low_stock yesterday.
oscar: I put it on the top shelf last week because the lid was loose. didn't think it was an issue. my bad.
ravi: Ooof might be the one I grabbed for the meeting urn. if the lid's loose we should move to sealed mason jars. less spill risk.
pantry-bot: Inventory update 1: house_blend_canister=0, sealed_mason_jars=4, instant_coffee=3, PB_jars=2. Low: house_blend_canister.
dayna: Also noticed the 'pantry pennies' jar is empty. We used to have a $1/mo run for basics. Do we want to restart that or use the team wallet? :coin: vote :thumbsup: for restart, :thumbsdown: for stop.
kitchen-ops: Suggestion 1: start a managed petty cash envelope in the supply closet and have one volunteer per week be the custodian. That way it's auditable and we don't have loose change.
elaine: Sounds good. Could we also get a Tupperware amnesty box? There are three mystery containers in the fridge with no names. They haunt me.
oscar: guilty of one of those but I swear it's mine? will claim if I see it.
ravi: I'll label mine. quick tip - the label printer is in supply-closet-2 on the wall mount. it has name+date stickers.
dayna: Can someone grab 2 sealed mason jars and a new canister lid from the hardware store? I'll reimburse from my team slack credits for this month if needed.
kitchen-ops: We have a spare lid in the 'coffee-spares' bin. I'll put it on the counter in 10. Also adding a little sign: "please reseal canister after use".
barista-bot: Brew schedule reminder 1: communal urn brewing at 9am and 2pm weekdays. Please pitch in if you finish the pot.
oscar: If someone is heading out for errands, grab a small jar of decaf beans and 2 mason jars? I'll Venmo for my share.
elaine: I'll take a run at 4pm. Who wants mason jars? Reply with :hand: and I'll add to the list.
oscar: :hand: can double-check the amnesty box and claim mine if it's labeled.
ravi: :hand: add a roll of stretch wrap too, lids keep falling off.
pantry-bot: New policy note added to fridge sticky: label leftovers with name + date, reseal coffee canister after use. Unlabeled items older than 72h will be moved to amnesty box for 24h then discarded.
dayna: Thanks all. little things make the kitchen less haunted. see you in the lobby, i'll drop slack-credit receipt in #finance-ops.
